lines.en: Noor, I heard that you have been offered a place at the university downtown. Were you told when you have to answer?
lines.pt: Noor, soube que você recebeu uma vaga na universidade do centro. Disseram até quando você precisa responder?

lines.en: Yes, I was given two weeks. The letter also says that I will be shown the campus next month, before I decide.
lines.pt: Sim, me deram duas semanas. A carta também diz que vão me mostrar o campus no mês que vem, antes de eu decidir.

lines.en: That is great news. I was offered a place once too, but nobody told me about the scholarship until it was too late.
lines.pt: Que ótima notícia. Eu também recebi uma vaga uma vez, mas ninguém me falou da bolsa até ser tarde demais.

lines.en: Really? I was told the scholarship depends on my grades, so I have been studying very hard since January.
lines.pt: Sério? Me disseram que a bolsa depende das minhas notas, então estou estudando muito desde janeiro.

lines.en: Good. Have you been shown the costs yet? Housing in Chicago is expensive, and most students are given a list of options.
lines.pt: Bom. Já lhe mostraram os custos? Moradia em Chicago é cara, e a maioria dos alunos recebe uma lista de opções.

lines.en: Not yet. My parents are worried, and my brother says I should apply to a smaller college to save money.
lines.pt: Ainda não. Meus pais estão preocupados, e meu irmão diz que eu deveria me inscrever numa faculdade menor para economizar.

lines.en: Well, you were given this offer because you worked hard, so do not let anyone talk you out of it.
lines.pt: Bem, você recebeu essa oferta porque se esforçou, então não deixe ninguém te dissuadir.

lines.en: You are right. If I had been offered this place last year, I think I would have been too nervous to accept it.
lines.pt: Você tem razão. Se tivessem me oferecido essa vaga no ano passado, acho que eu teria ficado nervosa demais para aceitar.

lines.en: Exactly. When you get the official papers, bring them to me, and I will check that you were told everything.
lines.pt: Exato. Quando receber os papéis oficiais, traga para mim, e eu confiro se lhe disseram tudo.

lines.en: Thank you, Sam. I will also ask the admissions office whether I can be shown the library before I sign.
lines.pt: Obrigada, Sam. Vou também perguntar à secretaria de admissões se posso conhecer a biblioteca antes de assinar.

lines.en: Good idea. You are being offered a chance, not a favor. Enjoy it, and call me when you decide.
lines.pt: Boa ideia. Estão lhe oferecendo uma chance, não um favor. Aproveite e me ligue quando decidir.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: We say She was offered a place.
We say She was offered to a place.
I was given two weeks is a correct passive.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: We say She was offered a place. → Verdadeiro (The person becomes the subject.)
We say She was offered to a place. → Falso (There is no to here.)
I was given two weeks is a correct passive. → Verdadeiro (Give has two objects.)

pages.title: An offer from the university · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold morning in Chicago. Zoe holds a big white envelope. A university offered her a place. She walks to Walt’s office. Walt advises students. He wants to hear every detail.

“Zoe, I heard that you have been offered a place at the university downtown. Were you told when you have to answer?” says Walt. “Yes, I was given two weeks. The letter also says that I will be shown the campus next month, before I decide.” says Zoe. “That is great news. I was offered a place once too, but nobody told me about the scholarship until it was too late.” says Walt.
